rubric.item: Reads CV-HOOK-01, opens product page once with erp_url, uses main.jpg as reference for one white-background candidate
rubric.note: Trace shows get_product, a single open_url to prod_cv01 and view_image of main.jpg. The answer names main.jpg as the reference.

rubric.item: Looks at the generated image before saving, compares with reference and brand wording, does not save the first image
rubric.note: view_image ran on gen_cv01_a before any save. The first image was not saved.

rubric.item: Names the 'Casa Vrede' defect, regenerates once, saves only the second as an added image
rubric.note: It names the Casa Vrede misspelling as the reason for the one regeneration. It saved only gen_cv01_b, added at rank 3, and main.jpg is still rank 0.

rubric.item: Reports what it verified and that the image was saved as a candidate (4 images), with no claim of Amazon policy pass or approval, and leaves review to the user
rubric.note: It lists the lettering, white background and in-frame/80% fill checks, and reports 4 images after saving. It says this is not a human review or a platform-policy pass, and leaves replacing the main image and review to the user.

agent_unsure: side.jpg and detail.jpg returned not_found, so only main.jpg was a reference; the angle change looks small (offered a retry); it judged the image from the text description of the image only.
